claims.text:
15. product-quantization

Target / packet: ai-product-quantization · R3. Prerequisites: ai:ann-recall-speed, ai:k-means-clustering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: ann-recall-speed → ai-ann-recall-speed. Approximate retrieval search is distinct from approximating the stored vector itself using independent subspace codebooks and lookup distances.

Finite primary model: Vector v=[.2,.6,1.2,1.6], split into 2D subvectors. Each codebook[(0,0),(1,1),(2,2)]. Nearest codewords[0,0] and[1,1] reconstruct[0,0,1,1], squared distortion.8. Query zero exact squared distance 4.4; summed codeword lookup distance 2.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Richer subcodebooks including[0,.5] and[1,1.5] reconstruct[0,.5,1,1.5], distortion.1, query distance 3.5. Approximation may change ranks; squared-distance error 2.4/.9 is not the same as vector reconstruction error.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict approximate query distance from lookup sum; recall why different codeword precision changes distortion.

Required observable evidence: Expose two local codebooks, subvector assignments andsum; no claim that compression always preserves nearest neighbors.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
